item.title: Ansible Fails waiting for privilege escalation on Ubuntu 26
item.description: I've slowly been moving my servers from Ubuntu 22 and 24 to 26 this year, and noticed my Ansible automation starts failing if I have password protection for sudo use: $ ansible-playbook main.yml -K BECOME password: PLAY [Security] ******************************************************* TASK [Gathering Facts] *********************************************************************** fatal: [my-server.local]: FAILED! => msg: 'Timeout (12s) waiting for privilege escalation prompt: ' Apparently Ubuntu's been rewriting system utilities in Rust, and the sudo-rs version that ships on Ubuntu 26.04 has some incompatiblities with the sudo I've used on servers for 20+ years.

Marginalia Search, Money, C++, Rust, AI, stuff
item.description: Title possibly signs checks the article doesn’t have backing for. This is just a brief pro forma project update. Not much new functionality or anything to announce, last few months have mostly been bug fixes and technical debt cleanup. Most big parts of the search engine are in place, and while there are many things that could be better, we’re less likely to straight up see massive new features, at least in the immediate future. Per familiar intuition from binary searches, the closer you get to your goal the smaller and more deliberate steps you need to take in order to get even closer.
